eos_records.label: JCPDS 42-1300, EOS from Clendenen and Drickamer, 66
eos_records.notes: Clendenen and Drickamer report the legacy compression parameters K0 = 190.5 GPa and K0' = 3.9 without parameter uncertainties. V0 is retained from the ambient diffraction card. The source describes measurements to several hundred kilobars but does not expose a recoverable CoO-specific maximum in the accessible metadata, so no exact numeric fit limit is asserted.
